name: project-advisory
description: Health check, implementation roadmap, growth council, venture board, invention lab and design studio for web projects.

plugins.name: project-advisory
plugins.description: Advice for a web project: a health check with a branded PDF report, an implementation roadmap, a weekly council that proposes and stress-tests ideas for growth, a venture board for what the business could become, an invention lab that invents new things for the site, app or tool itself, and a design studio that finds what a site could look, read and move like without copying or falling back on a template.
